fusions.name: Dug-Up Bones
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back. The nearest body within 9 tiles is dug up and bursts, dealing 8 damage plus 8% of its maximum health to everything within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Worry the Hide
fusions.desc: Sinks the tines in and holds on, dealing 14 damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Round Up
fusions.desc: Lays a herding line 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Brought Back
fusions.desc: A bonded hound fights beside you, biting an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
